item.tib: byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya pa
item.coloph: 'di bkod dge+e ba bdag la ci mchis te/ 'khrul pa'i mun nag gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ shes rab sgron gsal byang chub thob par shog sa'i rdul phran grangs bzhin 'phel gyur nas/ nyi ma'i zer bzhin sa steng yongs rgyas ste (te/)'gro rnams mnyam bsam bsgom pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ bdag gzhan don rtogs thar pa thob 'gyur cig don bcu gnyis pa gdams pa bstan pa'o/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i thabs tshigs su bcad pa gsum (sum) brgya nyi shu pa rdzogs so//
